Can you out-call a model?

Pick a league. Predict real matches the model has never seen, then watch the call and the result land. Every league has its own look, its own sounds and the same honest scoring.

Build 15 Nov 2026 15:38 UTC · public · results through 2026-11-08 Predictions come from a model that only ever saw earlier seasons (walk-forward), so every match you play was unseen. Bookmaker comparison uses average closing odds with the margin removed.
